plugin.shared: It is installed in the Project’s shared settings (.claude/settings.json): uninstalling it changes them for everyone working on the Project.

editor.label: Text of {{name}}

editor.saveFailed: The file could not be saved. Check that it can be written to, then save again.

problem.noFrontmatter: Start the file with its frontmatter: name and description between two lines of ---.
problem.unclosed: End the frontmatter with a line of --- after its last field.
problem.notFields: Write the frontmatter as fields, one name: value per line.
problem.badSkillName: Take out of name any < or >, invisible character, and any space but one between words.
problem.badSubagentName: Write name without a colon, and not starting with a hyphen.

closing.title_one: Claude is still working in a Session. Close ClaudeForge?
closing.title_other: Claude is still working in {{count}} Sessions. Close ClaudeForge?
closing.titleUnsaved_one: A skill or subagent has unsaved changes. Close ClaudeForge?
closing.titleUnsaved_other: {{count}} skills and subagents have unsaved changes. Close ClaudeForge?
closing.titleBoth: Claude is still working, and some changes are not saved. Close ClaudeForge?
closing.body: Closing stops every claude process ClaudeForge started. Each Session comes back as a tab the next time you open ClaudeForge, and the conversation so far stays in Claude Code’s history.
closing.bodyUnsaved: Closing discards the unsaved changes: each file stays as it was last saved.
